## Pull request overview

Adds a Changesets patch entry to publish the already-merged filter operator normalization fixes as a patch release across the monorepo’s fixed-version package group.

**Changes:**
- Add a patch changeset bumping `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/driver-memory`.
- Document the set of filter operator fixes included in the patch (e.g., `$notContains`, `$null`, normalization to Mingo-compatible queries).
